newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Finance Ministry investigating LME trades.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Finance Ministry investigating LME trades.

text.p: An official of South Korea's Finance Ministry said on Monday the ministry had summoned several domestic brokers to investigate overseas futures trading by Korean companies.
Lee Jong-gap, a director in the ministry's financial market division, said several brokers had been summoned.
"We called several brokers to check the current overseas futures trades by domestic companies," Lee said.
Korean brokers and traders said the ministry was probing a recent sharp increase in South Korean base metal futures and options trade on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"We were called by the Finance Ministry this morning," said one metal broker who asked not to be identified.
He said some metal brokers were asked to visit the minitsry office at 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Monday.
